What should you buy first?

For most people, protection comes first: a case and screen protector. After that, choose charging accessories based on how you actually use the phone. A power bank makes sense for travel; a desk charger makes sense if the phone spends much of the day beside a computer.

How we choose these daily picks

Our product comparisons are built using current retailer and manufacturer information, market analysis and practical buying factors. We do not physically test every item featured, so check independent reviews where durability, charging performance or long-term reliability matters.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an Apple-made case?

No. Third-party cases can be excellent. Check exact iPhone model compatibility, MagSafe alignment where relevant, raised edge protection, button access, warranty and returns.

Is MagSafe worth using?

It can be useful if you value magnetic alignment for chargers, stands, wallets and compatible battery packs. Whether it is worth paying more depends on how often you use those accessories.

Should I buy a power bank?

A portable battery is most useful if you travel, commute or regularly spend long periods away from a wall outlet.
